scope.purpose: Specify the next experimental design capable of discriminating action-conditioned future-space information from a baseline action preference or heuristic.

scientific_target.core_test: Determine whether action selection tracks an independently varied action-to-future-space correspondence rather than merely tracking action identity.

design.within_unit_structure: Each decision unit exposes the same current state, candidate action set, task context and timing while independently varying which action is associated with the informative future-space correspondence.
design.counterbalancing: Across the complete fixture, action identity and informative future-space correspondence must be independently counterbalanced so neither action is systematically privileged.
design.primary_contrast: Selection of the action associated with the informative future-space correspondence under counterbalanced action identity, compared against the corresponding action-selection baseline when that correspondence is unavailable.
design.mechanism_discriminator: A future-space mechanism predicts tracking of the currently assigned informative action across counterbalanced mappings; a fixed action preference predicts persistence of action identity independently of the mapping.

traceability.reconstruction_failure_policy: Exclude the unit from mechanism interpretation and fail the traceability gate if reconstruction cannot be independently established.

secondary_observables: Fixed-action preference rate across mapping reversals
analysis_plan.interpretive_rule: A mechanism claim requires the observed pattern to distinguish mapping-consistent selection from persistence of action identity under counterbalanced mappings. Descriptive differences alone are not sufficient.
analysis_plan.statistical_threshold: Not specified at this design gate; no inferential threshold is introduced retroactively.
